preconditions.description: The number of rows in the first map is at least 1 and at most 2000.
The number of columns in each map is at least 1 and at most 200.
The number of columns in the first map is at least as large as the number of columns in the second map.

postconditions.description: The starting row index i of the overlapping section in the first map is at least 1 and at most N - M + 1.
The starting column index j of the overlapping section in the second map is at least 1 and at most M - M + 1.

postconditions.expression: all(first_map[i + k][j + l] == second_map[k][l] for k in range(M) for l in range(M))
postconditions.description: The section of the first map starting at (i, j) is identical to the section of the second map starting at (j, i).
